grades.2: highly relevant - the passage directly and completely answers the query
grades.1: partially relevant - the passage is on-topic and contributes part of the answer

judging_protocol.method: Judgments are anchored to (doc_number, anchor_phrase) pairs rather than chunk ids, so the same labelled set stays valid when the corpus is re-chunked with a different strategy. At eval time every chunk of that document whose text contains the anchor phrase inherits the grade. Each query was labelled by reading the source circular first and locating the governing paragraph, then confirming no other document in the corpus states the same rule.
judging_protocol.known_limitations: Single annotator, so no inter-annotator agreement is reported. Graded 0/1/2 rather than binary. Queries were written before running any retrieval, to avoid retrieval-biased labelling.
